MOHAMMED V UNIVERSITY IN RABAT · FACULTY OF SCIENCES

Research Laboratory in Computer Science and Telecommunications

The Research Laboratory in Computer Science and Telecommunications (LRIT) brings together researchers working across computing, information processing and telecommunications.

Our research

Artificial intelligence and data science; signal, image and computer vision; networks, IoT and security; telecommunications and antennas; embedded systems, software engineering and applied intelligent systems.

Explore research areas ↗

Our community

Faculty members, associate researchers and doctoral students contribute to research, training and scientific cooperation.

Researcher directory ↗

Education

The Master’s programme in Computer Science and Telecommunications offers pathways in Computer Science and Applied AI, and Networks and Telecommunications. Doctoral training is conducted within the laboratory’s research areas.

Discover the Master’s programme ↗

Collaboration

LRIT’s activities include academic cooperation, joint supervision and research projects with academic and socioeconomic partners.
